Integrated with all existing components: XP system, pain memory, committee, risk guard, position manager, executor

phase5_deliverables: TradingEngine: scan_market(), evaluate_opportunity(), execute_trade(), check_and_update_positions(), run_one_cycle(), get_status(), persistence (state saved/loaded)
AutonomousLoop: 24/7 loop, market-aware states (TRADING, PREPARATION, REST), signal handling, session tracking, statistics
